trap.label: comparar dados
trap.wrong: Adults spend 6.5 hours, teens spend more that adults. Make a effort to sleep.
trap.right: Adults spend 6.5 hours. Teens spend more than adults. Make an effort to sleep.
trap.why: Em português “mais do que” e “um esforço” (um = a); o brasileiro usa that/a. Em inglês, comparativo usa than e an antes de vogal.

rewrite.answer: Teens spend more time than adults.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva no singular: “Adults spend 6.5 hours.” (An adult)
